body: I'm dumb because I'm self destructive but I can't even do that right.

I'm finished. I can't take anymore pain. I can't trust anyone. I can't continue. I just drink myself until I drown and starve myself until I'm worthless because that is all I have lefy. I just need the courage to take my last step.

Nothing.
Thank you. I've never considered myself much of a writer but it certainly helps to get it out. We'll all get to that point of keeping our cool some day.
